newsitem.title: USA: Barry's Jewelers fails to meet covenants.
newsitem.headline: Barry's Jewelers fails to meet covenants.

text.p: Barry's Jewelers Inc said it failed to meet certain financial covenants contained in an amended revolving credit agreement as of the February 28, 1997 testing date.

The company said that while it was continuing negotiations with the bank group to obtain a forebearance or waiver in the event of default, or a modification of the covenants, there could be no assurance they could be obtained on favourable terms.
Barry's Jewelers said the failure to meet the covenants constituted default under the credit pact.

Under terms of the amended credit agreement, Barry's said it could not make the interest payment due April 30, 1997 or any subsequent payment due under its 11 percent senior secured notes due December 22, 2000 after a default under the amended pact occured and until the default was waived.
